author: Stahly
description:
This one gets a bit obscure: on my last trip to Japan, I picked up an SD (super deformed) version of the iconic Evangelion Unit-01. A model kit from cavico's ChoiPla range, hand-painted by me. I'll walk you through every colour and technique I used. If you've got a soft spot for purple-green colour contrasts and/or 90s anime and mechs, read on.

The post I painted this cute chibi EVA-01 ChoiPla model kit, here’s how appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: I painted this cute chibi EVA-01 ChoiPla model kit, here’s how
